Add your friends

Upload profile pictures (PFPs) of your favorite CT friends. Add as many as you like — the more you add, the smaller each picture gets so everyone fits. Drag the round photos to change their order, or drop images anywhere on the preview above.

Tip: write each friend's @handle and it shows under their photo on the banner. Tap the star to make one best friend stand out with a gold ring and a bigger photo.

Install CT Circle Studio
1 On iPhone (Safari)

Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari, then tap Add to Home Screen, then Add. The CT Circle Studio icon appears on your home screen.
2 On Android (Chrome)

Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right, then tap Install app (or Add to Home screen), then confirm Install.
3 On computer (Chrome or Edge)

Click the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose Install CT Circle Studio.

Once installed, the studio opens full-screen like an app, and your saved design and history stay right where you left them.
